lockedApproved: This day is approved and permanently locked. The data recorded for this day are part of the KPI figures and can no longer be changed.
lockedSubmitted: This day has been submitted and is with the vessel supervisor. It can be changed again only if it is sent back.
stoppageDeleteFailed: The stoppage could not be removed.
stoppagesEmpty: No stoppages recorded for this day.
noDowntimeTypes: No downtime types are defined yet, so a stoppage cannot be logged. Head office maintains them under Downtime Types.
categoryFromType: Comes from the selected downtime type.
isPlannedPrefillNote: Prefilled from the downtime type and still yours to change. This row’s value is what the planned-downtime figure uses.
operatorOnlyTitle: This screen belongs to the Operator role
operatorOnlyBody: Only the vessel operator enters a daily report. Change role to continue.
noProjectBody: Choose a project above to see its days.
loadFailedTitle: This project’s days could not be loaded
noDaysBody: This project has no daily reports. Start the first one below.
cycleDeleteFailed: The cycle could not be removed.
cyclesEmpty: No cycles recorded for this day yet.
notesSaveFailed: The notes could not be saved.
volumeZeroNote: May be zero — a cycle that ran and produced nothing is still a cycle, and its time counts.
submitExplain: Submitting locks the day for editing and sends it to the vessel supervisor for review.
supervisorOnlyTitle: This screen belongs to the Vessel Supervisor role
supervisorOnlyBody: Only the vessel supervisor reviews a submitted day. Change role to continue.
nothingPendingBody: No submitted days are waiting for this project.
approveExplain: Approving locks this day permanently and admits it to KPI calculation. Rejecting returns it to the operator for correction, and the reason is recorded.
rejectionReasonPlaceholder: Required when rejecting — what must the operator correct?
projectControlOnlyTitle: This screen belongs to the Project Control role
dashboardRoleBody: The management dashboard belongs to head office. Change role to continue.
approvedOnlyNote: Every figure below is computed from APPROVED days only. Draft, submitted and rejected days are excluded.
dashboardLoadFailedTitle: This project’s figures could not be loaded
dashboardLoadFailed: The figures could not be loaded.
noApprovedDaysTitle: No approved reports for this project
noApprovedDaysBody: Days may exist as drafts or be awaiting review. Only approved days enter these figures, so there is nothing to compute yet.
tOpNote: Dredging + transport + discharge + return, across all cycles.
tAvNote: 1440 minutes per approved report (one 24-hour day each), minus planned downtime.
unaccountedPercent: Unaccounted — neither logged as work nor as a stoppage
dataQualityTitle: Not included in the buckets above
unclassifiedNote: Stoppage time in a category outside the three the FRD lists
unparseableNote: Cycle phases whose times could not be read
unparseableRoundTripNote: Cycles whose round trip could not be read, so they are absent from mean cycle time
projectControlOnlyBody: Head office defines projects, vessels and personnel. Change role to continue.
personnelExplain: The people who can be assigned to projects. Assigning someone to a project, with dates and a shift, is done on the personnel assignment screen.
personnelRemoveFailed: The person could not be removed.
noPersonnel: Nobody has been recorded yet. Add a person before assigning anyone to a project.
fullNameHint: Full name in one field, as the specification records it — not a first and last name.
personCreateFailed: The person could not be added.
noPersonSelected: No person was given to edit.
personLoadFailed: The person could not be loaded.
personSaveFailed: The person could not be updated.
endDateOptionalHint: Leave empty while the assignment is open. Setting it later is how someone leaving is recorded.
assignmentFailed: The assignment could not be recorded.
personnelAssignmentsExplain: A person is assigned to a project for a period. Someone leaving is recorded by setting an end date, which keeps the history; removing a row deletes it as though it never happened, and is for correcting a mistake.
activeOnDateHint: Changes which rows read as Active. It does not hide anything — every assignment for the project is listed.
referenceLoadFailed: Projects, personnel or shifts could not be loaded.
noProjectsForPersonnel: There are no projects yet. Someone is assigned to a project, so create a project first.
choosePersonnelProject: Choose a project to see who is assigned to it.
personnelAssignmentsLoadFailed: Personnel assignments could not be loaded.
assignmentRemoveFailed: The assignment could not be removed.
noPersonnelOnProject: Nobody has been assigned to this project yet — not even in the past.
noAssignmentSelected: No assignment was given to edit.
assignmentLoadFailed: The assignment could not be loaded.
assignmentNotFound: That assignment no longer exists. It may have been removed on another tab.
assignmentFixedFields: The person and the project cannot be changed. Moving someone is ending this assignment and starting another, so that the record of where they were stays true.
endDateEditHint: Setting this records that the person has left the project; the row stays and keeps the history. Clearing it reopens the assignment.
assignmentSaveFailed: The assignment could not be updated.
searchProjects: Search by code or contract subject…
projectsEmpty: No projects are defined yet. Create the first one.
projectCreateFailed: The project could not be created.
projectSeedExplain: Enough to create the record. The contract detail is completed on the next screen. The project code is generated by the system.
projectSaveFailed: The project could not be saved.
noProjectSelectedBody: Choose a project from the list, or create a new one.
projectLoadFailedTitle: This project could not be loaded
projectLoadFailed: The project could not be loaded.
stoppageTypesExplain: Entered once here, then chosen from when a stoppage is logged. “Planned” is the default a stoppage inherits when this type is selected — the logged stoppage keeps its own value, and that is what the KPI figures use.
searchStoppageTypes: Search by code, name or category…
stoppageTypesLoadFailed: Downtime types could not be loaded.
stoppageTypesNoMatch: No downtime type matches that search.
stoppageTypesEmpty: No downtime types are defined. Until one exists, an operator has nothing to choose from when logging a stoppage.
downtimeCodeNote: Identifies the type when an operator selects it, so it must be unique.
downtimeCategoryNote: The dashboard buckets technical and operational downtime by this value. A category outside those two is valid, and its time is reported separately rather than dropped.
downtimeIsPlannedNote: A DEFAULT for stoppages logged with this type. The logged stoppage keeps its own value, and that is what T_PD is computed from.
duplicateCodeTitle: That code is already in use
stoppageTypeCreateFailedTitle: The downtime type could not be created
stoppageTypeCreateFailed: The downtime type could not be created.
stoppageTypeLoadFailedTitle: This downtime type could not be loaded
subprojectsEmpty: This project has no subprojects yet. Create the first one.
subprojectCreateFailed: The subproject could not be created.
noParentProjectTitle: A subproject needs a parent project
noParentProjectBody: Open the subprojects list, choose a project, and create it from there.
subprojectSeedExplain: Enough to create the record. The rest is completed on the next screen. The subproject code is generated from the parent project’s code.
subprojectSaveFailed: The subproject could not be saved.
noSubprojectSelectedBody: Choose a project, then a subproject from its list.
subprojectLoadFailedTitle: This subproject could not be loaded
subprojectLoadFailed: The subproject could not be loaded.
assignExplain: A project has exactly one vessel for its whole life. If the project already has one, this will be refused — correct the existing record instead.
assignRefusedTitle: This project already has a vessel
assignFailedTitle: The assignment could not be made
assignFailedBody: The assignment could not be made.
assignRefusedExplain: The one-to-one is part of the model, not a rule this screen applies: a project has one assignment record for its whole life. There is no reassignment — correct that record, or record a release date on it.
vesselAssignmentsExplain: Each project has exactly one vessel, for its whole life. There is no reassignment: a mistake is corrected on the single record, and an end of work is recorded as a release date.
assignmentsLoadFailed: Vessel assignments could not be loaded.
noProjectsToAssign: There are no projects yet. A vessel is assigned to a project, so create a project first.
correctionFailed: The correction could not be saved.
noAssignmentProjectBody: Open the assignment list and choose the project whose record you want to correct.
noAssignmentTitle: This project has no vessel assignment
vesselCorrectionNote: Changing this corrects which vessel the project is recorded against. It is not a reassignment — there is one record per project and no history of a previous vessel.
releaseDateNote: When this vessel’s work on the project ended. Leave empty while the work continues. It does not hand the project to another vessel.
searchVessels: Search by name, code or type…
vesselsEmpty: No vessels are defined yet. Create the first one.
vesselCreateFailed: The vessel could not be created.
vesselSeedExplain: Enough to create the record. The full technical specification is completed on the next screen. The vessel code is generated by the system.
vesselSaveFailed: The vessel could not be saved.
noVesselSelectedBody: Choose a vessel from the list, or create a new one.
vesselLoadFailedTitle: This vessel could not be loaded
vesselLoadFailed: The vessel could not be loaded.
forbiddenTitle: This page is not available in your role
forbiddenBody: Each DMS role sees a different part of the system. Switch role to continue.
rolePickerNotice: Development role switcher. DMS roles are not part of the Auth service and this selection is stored in a browser cookie — it decides which screens are shown, and it is not authentication.
rolePickerBlocked: The page you asked for needs a role to be chosen first.
projectRolesExplain: The roles a person can hold on a project, chosen when personnel are assigned. This is a fixed reference list from the specification and is not maintained here.
shiftsExplain: Entered once here, then chosen from when personnel are assigned to a project. The time range is recorded as free text, exactly as written — it is a label, not a duration the system calculates with.
shiftsEmpty: No shifts are defined. Until one exists, an assignment cannot record which shift someone works.
shiftNameNote: How the shift is chosen when assigning personnel, so two shifts cannot share a name.
shiftTimeRangeNote: Recorded as text, exactly as written. It is a label shown beside the shift, not a duration the system calculates with.
shiftCreateFailed: The shift could not be created.
shiftLoadFailed: The shift could not be loaded.
shiftSaveFailed: The shift could not be saved.
